groupTitle: Nike 6 Pack Everyday Plus Cushioned Socks - Men's

model.name: Nike 6 Pack Everyday Plus Cushioned Socks - Men's
model.description:
Power through your workout with the Nike Everyday Plus + Cushion Crew Training Socks (6 Pair).

• Dri-FIT technology helps you stay dry and comfortable.

• Breathable mesh at the top of the foot for enhanced ventilation.

• Crew silhouette provides comfortable coverage around the ankle and calf.

• Arch band contours around the foot for a locked in fit.

• 67% cotton/30% polyester/2% spandex/1% nylon. Imported.
